name: A Sacred Burial
summary: At Red Rocks in eastern Mulgore, Lorekeeper Raintotem calls on Horde adventurers to protect the sacred burial grounds. Bristleback quilboar have overrun the graves of tauren warriors who gave their lives founding and defending Thunder Bluff.

sections.title: Hallowed Ground of the Shu'halo
sections.body: Red Rocks is among Mulgore's most revered sanctuaries, set in the crags beneath the eastern mountains. Only the most valiant tauren are laid to rest there. These legendary warriors shed blood to protect their tribes and their chieftains, and to carve out a lasting homeland atop Thunder Bluff's mesas. To the Shu'halo, disturbing their rest insults both tradition and the Earth Mother.

sections.title: The Bristleback Desecration
sections.body: The nomadic Bristleback quilboar have long contested tauren control over central Kalimdor. Their recent push into Red Rocks is a grave escalation. Bands of Bristleback Interlopers have crept onto the holy grounds, ravaging the earth and disturbing the resting places. Lorekeeper Raintotem is too aged to drive them away alone, so young Horde champions must take up arms and defend the honored dead.

faq.answer: Red Rocks is a sacred ancestral cemetery along Mulgore's eastern mountains. It is reserved for the most valiant tauren warriors, especially those who died protecting their tribes and founding Thunder Bluff.
Lorekeeper Raintotem is an elder tauren who tends and safeguards Red Rocks. Past his prime and unable to repel the Bristlebacks alone, he calls on capable adventurers to defend the dead.

faq.q: Why are the Bristleback quilboar at Red Rocks?
aliases: why are quilboar at red rocks
faq.answer: The Bristleback tribe presses against tauren territory across Mulgore and the Barrens. Seeking territory and resources, bands of interlopers have pushed into Red Rocks' crags and desecrated the graves.

faq.q: Why is this desecration so offensive to the tauren?
faq.answer: Tauren honor their ancestors and seek balance with the spirits of the fallen. When quilboar ravage the earth and disturb the bones of heroes who died for Thunder Bluff, the insult is deeply spiritual.

faq.q: Where does this quest lead next?
faq.answer: A Sacred Burial is a defensive task offered by Lorekeeper Raintotem. Once the Bristleback Interlopers are dealt with, the immediate desecration is halted.

faq.q: Who is buried at Red Rocks?
faq.answer: Red Rocks is reserved for champion tauren who fought for the survival of their tribes and chieftains. Their sacrifices made the establishment and defense of Thunder Bluff possible.

angles.text: As a tauren, you help keep Red Rocks undisturbed and honor the ancestors who made your people's unified homeland possible.
As a shaman, you answer the desecration of sacred grounds, which agitates the honored ancestors' spirits and makes your intervention necessary.
As a member of the Horde, you help tauren elders secure their sacred monuments and uphold the Horde's pledge to defend Mulgore alongside its allies.
